name: Hazuki You
source:
Birth year: 1992

[url=/c88248]Tsubame[/url]'s younger sister. 
You is 2 years younger than Tsubame. She always tags along wherever her older sister goes. Loves ice cream and lazing around at home.

Main character of "Story 1 - Bottomless cave"

Main character of "Story 2 - School, a close friend and me"

Protagonist of "Story 3 - Crimson hair"

A month later after [url=/c92080]Rei[/url]'s incident. You and her older sister Tsubame decided to spend their last few days of summer break going on a trip to a beach villa of her mother's friend. Not long after coming there, Tsubame disappeared, and while trying to find her sister, You stumbled upon an abandoned village and met a mysterious girl.

[spoiler] Protagonist of "Story 4 - Shimaigusa"

Not long after her sister's death, You started seeing eerie things that she has never experienced before. Terrified of the fact, she became a shut-in, cutting every tie to the outside world. However, the quiet days living as a hikikomori are broken the moment You received a mysterious call from Sumire in the midst of an incident...[/spoiler]
